PR.body:
This accepts the complete focal antipedal sum equality for the original two-confocal-ellipses target k603 (problem 5100032 / AMR-050-0032). The verified result is published as **A telescoping proof of the focal antipedal sum invariant**, Alec Kriebel, version 1.0 (6 October 2026), [DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23191247](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23191247). The published PDF and supporting verification archive were downloaded and checked in full, and the publication tracker was independently read back at `'Math Puzzles'!A32:D32`.

For an outer ellipse with semiaxes a>b>0 and a fixed strictly nested confocal elliptical caustic 0<lambda<b², the sums of **ordinary positive** focal antipedal radial distances are equal along every regular closed nonretracing billiard/Poncelet orbit. The proof includes every admitted period and winding, odd primitive periods, stars, reversal and repetition. It does not assert separate constancy of either sum, or extend the theorem to hyperbolic, focal, degenerate or retracing cases.

The edge identity is q_plus−q_minus = Gamma·(y_next−y_current), where c²=a²−b² and Gamma=c[−a²+b²lambda/(b²−lambda)]/(ab sqrt(lambda)). Consistent caustic-side orientation and closure make this telescope. The manuscript proves the ordinary-positive norm formula and treats horizontal edges and the zero coefficient without dividing by displacement or coefficient.

The observation is credited to Reznik, Garcia and Koiller; classical antipedal geometry and known focal-height identities are credited as background. The in-depth, dated priority audit included the supplied full Garcia–Koiller–Reznik journal paper and its precursor. No earlier covering theorem was found in the inspected corpus. The note states the corpus/version limits and makes no exhaustive or absolute-first priority claim.

Validation includes a self-contained proof, independently derived identities, exact rational finite controls, genuine faulty subprocess rejection, and two fresh adversarial reviews of the complete publication package. Finite computational controls support the written proof; they are not a substitute for its all-real argument. AI tools were used extensively in solving, drafting and verification. The preprint is unrefereed and has not received conventional human peer review; independent AI-agent reviews are explicitly distinguished from such review.

All seventeen original submitted files remain byte-for-byte under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/5100032/historical_original/`, including the original proof and the nonempty imported prior. The exact source and prior are also preserved in the current attempt. The literal original status remains `claimed_solved`, with original effort **2/5** and no additional central proof-search turn. The dated native import records those facts without fabricating two historical structured events or a missing historical readiness ledger. Full mathematical acceptance and published evidence are recorded separately.

Integration uses a reviewed native assessment and a narrowly scoped offer preserving unrelated scores, record/key and physical CSV order, historical prefixes, current campaigns and the current main queue. The final main-only merge retains the reviewed acceptance tree exactly and records the unchanged original PR head `3d159f0a00d0bd7ff8d558d6fbc75af5094f7a35` as its second parent. The actual native acceptance receipt supplies the later live acceptance state; candidate-only files remain dated preparation evidence.

The native assessment was actually performed once against original main `f9f840d21305bdc353d151abe8dd5c51b6a27dd6`. Integration onto `e0a94b93520610553c001f265f210f959b591c2c` retains the independently authenticated unrelated problem30005460 row and63 new attempt files. Eleven native input bodies are byte-identical; the exact QUEUE row delta was checked in full. The original worker was not reassessed against the newer main. All three stopped workspaces remain preserved; the separate carryforward candidate and later live acceptance receipt bind the historical assessment and current integration explicitly.

The later carryforward preparation stopped at the original CPU limit while generating the complete comparison. Its partial offer remains nonexportable and unchanged. The new candidate uses a complete linear-time replacement diff, independently applied back to every full before-body to reconstruct the exact offered after-body. The original CPU90/inner-wall120 policy is unchanged; the native assessment is not repeated.
PR.title: Accept PR110: focal antipedal invariant k603 proved and published
